resources.string: Choose a listening language for this meeting. Room managers open or close shared channels. Leaving a channel changes only your listening; translated text stays separate from originals.
Sign in to choose an interpretation channel.
Interpretation is unavailable for this meeting.
Check the original request before changing channels or listening.
Wait for this device’s meeting connection to be confirmed before listening.
The operation or listening state is unconfirmed. Refresh or check the original request, then choose a channel again.
Open this shared language channel. Translation begins when someone chooses to listen and may consume AI usage. Opening the channel does not subscribe you automatically.
Close this language channel for everyone currently listening. They will stop receiving its translated voice. The meeting continues.
